career_ladder.note: Provincial Civil Service (Executive Branch) officers in Uttar Pradesh start as Sub-Divisional Magistrates (SDM) / Deputy Collectors and progress through state administrative postings before being inducted into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under the promotion quota (IAS Appointment by Promotion Regulations).

exam_scheme.note: Examination consists of three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening), Main Examination (Conventional descriptive written across 8 compulsory papers; optional subjects were eliminated and replaced by UP Special GS Papers V & VI), and Interview / Personality Test (100 marks).

financial_package.note: Provincial Civil Service posts in Uttar Pradesh are compensated under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. The premier cadre posts (Deputy Collector / SDM and DSP) start at Pay Matrix Level 10 (Pay Band 3: ₹15,600 - 39,100, Grade Pay ₹5,400) with entry basic pay of ₹56,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Government of Uttar Pradesh, Finance Department — U.P. Revised Pay Rules 2016, Pay Matrix Level 10 (SDM/Deputy Collector Entry Scale)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on UP Pay Matrix Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹56,100 at 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025) across Class A/B/C districts of Uttar Pradesh (HRA 27%/18%/9% or 30%/20%/10% depending on municipal classification); net in-hand reflects standard deductions for NPS (10% on Basic+DA) and GIS.
official_perks: Government residential accommodation (type according to seniority and district posting)
Official vehicle with driver for field duty and executive inspections
Armed security guard / police escort for SDM and DSP posts
Subsidized electricity, water, and telephone allowances
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment
Comprehensive government medical coverage under UP Government Health Scheme (UPGHS)
